featured_reviews.name: Naresh RK
featured_reviews.review_text:
Orchid’s Vikhroli was genuinely good in its early years, however the current experience does not reflect the same standards. I hope the management revisits its priorities and brings the focus back to stable faculty, academic quality, and student well-being, rather than optics alone.

My ward studied here Jr KG to 3rd when the campus had newly opened during that early phase the school showed real promise. At the time, it had qualified and certified teachers, polite and supportive staff, and a well-structured curriculum. The overall learning environment felt student-centric and reassuring for parents.

However, post-COVID, the school seems to have lost its original charm and academic focus. There has been frequent change of teachers and principals, which directly impacted continuity and quality in education. Over time, the emphasis appears to have shifted more toward gloss and branding, while education has taken a back seat.

The fee hikes have been steep, without a commensurate improvement in academic delivery. Additionally, the school follows very rigid policies around fee payments—if fees are delayed, portal access is blocked, students may not be allowed to sit for exams, and in some cases entry to the school itself is restricted, which feels excessive and stressful for both parents and children.

In my building itself 3-4 kids shifted to other school this year too & got to hear same issue from a teacher who is no longer with orchid now led me to write this review which I was holding for years .. I hope it’s useful for parents, many thanks as well as apologies to orchid for this …
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for sharing your detailed feedback and for being a part of the Orchids family during your ward's early learning years. We appreciate your concerns regarding faculty stability, academic continuity, fee policies, and overall school experience. Your feedback has been noted and will be shared with the concerned team for review. For any other queries or suggestions, please reach out to us at escalations@orchids.edu.in with your ERP ID and contact details. Our team will review your request and respond promptly.

Schedule a visit to your nearest EuroKids Preschool today and give your child the right foundation.

A strong foundation in preschool education helps children develop active listening, curiosity, emotional readiness, and social skills needed for a smooth classroom transition. Structured learning programs focused on holistic child development to ensure kids are prepared not just academically but also emotionally and socially for their school journey. Build a strong start with learning experiences designed to support growth, independence, and confidence in every child. At EuroKids, we bridge that gap, so your child does not just start school; they enter completely ready to thrive. Give your child the Flying Start they deserve. Admissions OPEN for AY 2026-27! featured_reviews.name: Aditya Sawant
featured_reviews.review_text: Attending my child’s playgroup annual concert for the first time was such a heartwarming experience! The little ones, dressed in adorable costumes, performed with so much enthusiasm and innocence that it instantly filled the auditorium with joy. The teachers and staff did an amazing job organizing everything—from the decorations to the smooth transitions between performances. It was lovely to see how much effort went into making each child feel special on stage. The songs, dances, and tiny skits were simply delightful and left everyone smiling. Overall, it was a memorable event.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much, Aditya Sawant, for sharing your joyful experience at our playgroup annual concert! We're thrilled the adorable costumes and smooth organization made it memorable. It means a lot to hear how special the children felt on stage. Looking forward to many more happy moments together! – EuroKids PreSchool Ghatkopar East

I also appreciate how the activities are both fun and meaningful allowing kids to learn new things without any pressure.

All in all, it’s a place where children look forward to coming every day and learn with confidence.
